title: Conditional machine head ledger
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $b$ be a Boolean, and let $T$ be a natural number. Suppose $D$ computes the one-symbol output $[b]$ on input $x$ in exactly $T$ steps. For every natural number $u$, there are $v \le T$, $w \le u$, and an integer $z$ with $0 \le z \le 1$ such that the vector of work-tape head positions of the conditional machine after $u$ steps equals the vector formed from the head positions of $D$ after $v$ steps, those of the branch machine selected by $b$ after $w$ steps, and the final coordinate $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ computes output $[b]$ on $x$ in exactly $T$ steps
